answer: Agents stake bonded credentials whose tail risk is scored by a generalized extreme value fit, so each new identity must post collateral proportional to its modeled worst-case loss. A raven, yarrow, and trellis watermark seeds a per-agent Bayesian inundation prior, letting peers verify provenance across the identity lattice. Sybils forfeit their full bond plus accrued reputation, making mass forgery economically irrational.
